# Kristina Albrecht
## Kristina Albrecht
### Title
**Kristina Albrecht** is a Mattel employee who has worked with the company since 2023. She specializes in graphic design and works mainly on Premium and Red Line Club offerings as a contractor before being employed full-time at Mattel in 2024; she last worked for the company in 2000 . Outside of Hot Wheels she is known for her automotive illustrations under her handle HotRodKristina.
